mn53:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn53:2.1: tena kho pana samayena kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvuṭṭhapubbaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
mn53:2.2: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn53:2.3: idha bhante kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvuṭṭhapubbaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena
mn53:2.4: taṃ bhante bhagavā paṭhamaṃ paribhuñjatu bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā kāpilavatthavā sakyā paribhuñjissanti
mn53:2.5: tadassa kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
mn53:3.2: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena navaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santhāgāraṃ santharāpetvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
mn53:3.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn53:3.5: sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ bhante santhāgāraṃ āsanāni paññattāni udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito telappadīpo āropito
mn53:4.1: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimathambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
mn53:4.2: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā.
mn53:4.3: kāpilavatthavāpi kho sakyā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā.
mn53:5.1: atha kho bhagavā kāpilavatthave sakye bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
mn53:5.2: paṭibhātu taṃ ānanda kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekho paṭipado
mn53:5.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn53:5.6: atha kho bhagavā catuguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
mn53:6.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando mahānāmaṃ sakkaṃ āmantesi
mn53:6.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti indriyesu guttadvāro hoti bhojane mattaññū hoti jāgariyamanuyutto hoti sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
mn53:7.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
mn53:7.3: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti.
mn53:8.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
mn53:8.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
mn53:8.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
mn53:8.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
mn53:8.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
mn53:8.10: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
mn53:9.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako bhojane mattaññū hoti.
mn53:9.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
mn53:9.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti
mn53:9.4: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako bhojane mattaññū hoti.
mn53:10.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
mn53:10.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
mn53:10.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā
mn53:10.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
mn53:10.6: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako jāgariyamanuyutto hoti.
mn53:11.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti.
mn53:11.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
mn53:11.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
mn53:12.1: hirimā hoti hiriyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
mn53:13.1: ottāpī hoti ottapati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena ottapati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
mn53:14.1: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā supaṭividdhā
mn53:15.1: āraddhaviriyo hoti akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
mn53:16.1: satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā
mn53:17.1: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā
mn53:17.2: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti.
mn53:18.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
mn53:18.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn53:18.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn53:18.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn53:18.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn53:18.6: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
mn53:19.1: yato kho mahānāma ariyasāvako evaṃ sīlasampanno hoti evaṃ indriyesu guttadvāro hoti evaṃ bhojane mattaññū hoti evaṃ jāgariyamanuyutto hoti evaṃ sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti evaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako sekho paṭipado apūccaṇḍatāya samāpanno bhabbho abhinibbhidāya bhabbho sambodhāya bhabbho anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
mn53:19.2: seyyathāpi mahānāma kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā tānassu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā parisecitāni sammā paribhāvitāni kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
mn53:19.3: aho vatime kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyunti
mn53:19.5: evameva kho mahānāma yato ariyasāvako evaṃ sīlasampanno hoti evaṃ indriyesu guttadvāro hoti evaṃ bhojane mattaññū hoti evaṃ jāgariyamanuyutto hoti evaṃ sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti evaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako sekho paṭipado apūccaṇḍatāya samāpanno bhabbho abhinibbhidāya bhabbho sambodhāya bhabbho anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
mn53:20.1: sa kho so mahānāma ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
mn53:20.2: seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
mn53:21.1: sa kho so mahānāma ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti
mn53:22.1: sa kho so mahānāma ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
mn53:23.1: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ
mn53:23.2: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako indriyesu guttadvāro hoti idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ
mn53:23.3: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako bhojane mattaññū hoti idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ
mn53:23.4: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako jāgariyamanuyutto hoti idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ
mn53:23.5: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ
mn53:23.6: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ
mn53:24.1: yañca kho mahānāma ariyasāvako anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati idampissa hoti vijjāya
mn53:24.2: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti idampissa hoti vijjāya
mn53:24.3: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati idampissa hoti vijjāya
mn53:25.1: ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako vijjāsampanno itipi caraṇasampanno itipi vijjācaraṇasampanno itipi.
mn53:25.7: sā kho panesā mahānāma brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā na duggītā subhāsitā na dubbhāsitā atthasañhitā no anatthasañhitā anumatā bhagavatāti.
mn53:26.1: atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
mn53:26.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ ānanda kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekhapaṭipadaṃ abhāsīti.
mn53:26.6: attamanā kāpilavatthavā sakyā āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
